newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-SoundView bullish on Quantum.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-SoundView bullish on Quantum.

text.p: SoundView Financial Group Inc's analyst Mark Specker made bullish comments about fundamentals in the disk drive industry as well as disk drive maker Quantum Corp, driving the stock up 1-3/4 to 35-7/8.
The stock hit a new 52-week high of 36-1/2.
-- Specker raised fiscal 1998 earnings to $2.68 from $2.62 and set a fiscal 1999 estimate of $3.16.
-- He raised his three month price target to $40 from $30. The stock remains a short-term buy and a long-term hold.
-- "The fourth quarter could be very good for drives in general when PC units tend to ramp up the biggest," he said.

-- "This morning we published some data from the channel and we found, for Quantum in particular, inventories seemed pretty clearly to be stabilizing and some of the very big price drops in distribution stabilized as well. So while things aren't all of a sudden peachy keen, fundamentals for disk drives have probably bottomed," Specker said.
-- "Coupled with an increasingly better story with the back to school build, this could be a buying signal for the big investors to get back into this stock," he said.
-- For Quantum, he also cited strength in the company's tape business.

-- "We have a buy on Western Digital Corp as well. My numbers still show their inventory is still a little high and their price drops .. a little large but the stocks tend to be treated as a group. They could all turn at the same time, and this could be the time," he said.
-- Western Digital shares rose 1-7/16 to 46-15/16 and touched a new year high of 47-7/8.
-- "I'm not quite as enthusiastic about Seagate. They could continue to lose some high-end share," Specker said.
-- Seagate Technology Inc shares rose 9/16 to 44-7/8.
